admission.justification: A stale setter interface can make return fail after the subject changes, losing the captured reading position.

applicability: Return from a followed intent marker in the existing review workspace.
conditions: Capture holds subject, chosen family context and worklist only.
Restore selects captured subject/context before restoring worklist because choosing a subject leaves worklist.
The tree-focus request is cleared for marker return.
exclusions: Removed workspace opened-file, layout and Full file state is not reconstructed.
Comparison-viewer Back/Escape is a separate return path.

evidence: markerNavigation.test.ts 5/5 green; temporary real-store probe (useWorkspaceState capture/restore) 1/1, then removed (s3-triage.log)

statement: Returning from a followed marker restores the captured subject and family context before the worklist view, and clears the tree-focus request on return.
